description: Ground truth for scripts/check_room_coords.py. Problems are hard failures (exit 1); warnings W1 (stacked rooms) and W2 (direction/coord mismatch) are inherent to the source LPC graph and must NOT fail the check. Measured 2026-09-30.

exit_codes.1: at least one problem found, or the file could not be read/decoded
exit_codes.2: wrong argument count; usage printed to stderr

invariants: The tool must never raise an uncaught exception or print a traceback, for ANY input (including invalid UTF-8, truncated files and files with no rooms).
W1 and W2 are warnings only: over-reporting them as problems is a failure.
Under-reporting a problem is a failure.

cases.why: 1 room at the origin with an empty room_exits block: no problems, no warnings.
room 'hall' has x/z but no y: the coords script never handled it.
problems: room hall is missing a coordinate

cases.why: room 'island' has full coordinates but no exit path back to the origin room.
room_exits 'ghost' has no matching rooms block.
problems: room_exits ghost has no matching rooms block

cases.why: 3 rooms share (0,0,0) and are linked by (0,0,0) portal exits, so reachability and direction/coord agreement both hold. Isolates W1 with zero W2.
centre --north--> far but far is at (3,3,3). Coordinates do not collide, so this isolates W2 with zero W1.
file contains only an items block: nothing to check reachability against.
raw invalid UTF-8 bytes; must be reported cleanly, never as a traceback.
